Discover stylish knitwear for every season

Looking for a women’s jumper or knitted sweater that brings together comfort, elegance, and warmth? At Knit Factory, you’ll find a wide collection of pullovers, turtlenecks and sleeveless sweaters that are perfect for every season. Whether you want a relaxed everyday outfit or a refined layered look, our knitwear suits your lifestyle.

From chunky knits to refined layers

Our women’s jumpers and sweaters are available in a variety of styles, colours and fits. From oversized winter styles to breathable pieces for spring, there’s a perfect knit for every occasion. Add a turtleneck for cold days, layer with a spencer or go for a timeless knitted pullover – the combinations are endless.

Comfortable fits and soft materials

Each sweater is made from high-quality materials like cotton blends and soft acrylic yarns. The result? Durable knitwear that feels good and lasts long. Whether you prefer a classic round neck, a cosy roll neck or a sleeveless style, you’ll find it here.

Colours to suit every mood

From earthy tones like taupe, moss and anthracite to lively shades like terra and ochre – our collection lets you dress according to your mood. Mix, match and layer your way through the seasons with Knit Factory jumpers that express your unique style.

Order women’s sweaters online

Order before 4:00 PM and we’ll ship your favourite sweater the same day. With easy returns and Dutch design you can count on, Knit Factory brings warmth and style right to your door.

Inspiration

Be inspired by our blogs full of styling tips, seasonal favourites and creative ideas. Whether you’re updating your home or refreshing your wardrobe – discover how to bring your unique style to life with Knit Factory.
